Act on Specified Commercial Transactions

■ Distributor
QualiArts, Inc

■ Head of Sales
Yoshitatsu Tsujioka

■ Head Office
Address: Abema Towers, 40-1 Udagawacho, Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan 150-0042
Phone Number: 03-6386-3935 (Representative)

■ Contact Information
Please contact us via the [Contact Us] menu in game.

Business Hours
10:00~19:00 (JST) (Excl. Sat/Sun)

■ Retail Price
Each product is listed separately. Sales tax is listed as tax included.

■ Required charges other than the product price
Separate data charges from your mobile carrier will apply for an internet connection.
Mobile data charges or data plan fees may apply when accessing this service from a mobile phone.
* The amount is determined by each mobile carrier with whom you have contracted.

■ Delivery Schedule
The item will immediately be delivered after the purchase process is complete.

■ Payment Periods and Methods
Credit Card: Payment is confirmed at the time of ordering. Payment times vary by card company.
Mobile Carrier Billing: This will be billed along with your mobile phone charges. The payment time is subject to the mobile carrier's policies.
Prepaid Payment Instruments: Payment is made at the time of purchase.
Other payment methods provided by companies that handle payment processing for purchases: Payment methods can vary depending on the payment processor you use. Payment dates are subject to the regulations of the payment processor.

■ Product Returns・Exchanges
Due to the nature of the product, we cannot cancel, return or exchange any items after purchase.

■ Application Period
The period is displayed separately for each product (as shown on each product page).

■ System Requirements ・Recommended Devices
▼iOS
Recommended OS： iOS 16 or higher
Recommended device: 6 GB of RAM or more (iPhone 14 and higher)

▼iPadOS
Recommended OS： iPadOS 16 or higher
Recommended device: 6 GB of RAM or more

*Recommended system requirements and device specifications as of July 2026.

■ Purchases by minors
If the user is a minor, please obtain parental consent before making a purchase. Regarding Blue Diamonds, please be sure to review and consent to the [In-Game Currency Guidelines] before making a purchase.

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT AND HOW WE COLLECT IT

Personal Information We Collect 

When we talk about personal information (or personal data) we mean any information that relates to an identified or identifiable living individual.  Personal Data Received from Third Parties

We may receive social media account information if you choose to use a social login service, such as Facebook Login, to create or access your account.

 Automatic Data-Collection Technologies 

When you access and use our Service we will collect certain Usage Data and Technical Data.

The automatic data collection technologies we use to collect Technical Data may include:

 Cookies (or pixel tags and other similar technologies browser cookies). A cookie is a small file placed on the hard drive of your computer or device. You may refuse to accept browser cookies by activating the appropriate setting on your browser. However, if you select this setting you may be unable to access certain parts of our Service. Unless you have adjusted your browser setting so that it will refuse cookies, our system will issue cookies when you direct your browser to our Service. 

 Web Beacons. Our Service and our e-mails may use small electronic files known as web beacons (also referred to as clear gifs, pixel tags, and single-pixel gifs) that permit us, for example, to count users who have visited those pages or opened an e-mail and for other related website statistics (for example, recording the popularity of certain website content and verifying system and server integrity). 

 Resettable Device Identifiers. If you use an QualiArts App, we may collect a resettable device identifier from your device. Resettable device identifiers can be used like cookies and are found on many mobile devices and tablets (for example, the “Identifier for Advertisers” on Apple iOS devices and the “Google Advertising ID” on Android devices). Like cookies, resettable device identifiers are used to make online advertising more relevant, and for analytics and optimization purposes.

You may also control the information that we collect through the settings in your browser or mobile device.  You may configure your browser to reject cookies from QualiArts and may adjust the settings of your mobile device to prevent our Service from obtaining location information. Talent Guidelines

■ Introduction
This work is produced and operated as a game featuring talents from hololive Production
with respect for their real-life activities and consideration of various circumstances.

Because a talent’s activities can change depending on circumstances at any given time,
this may affect the content and timing of their implementation in the game.
These guidelines explain our principles and response policies on those points for users to understand them in advance.

■About the handling of graduated talents
This work may feature talents who have graduated or who have ended their streaming activities.
However, the way it is handled will change depending on the individual talent.

For example, here are such cases:
・No appearance in the game at all
・Only certain content appears
・Not included in sales items or new content
* The above are just some examples; actual procedures may vary by talent.
Our response may vary depending on the situation.

These differences are due to the production status at the time of development and the results of consultations with the parties involved.
All decisions were made with the agreement of the parties involved and are not based on any specific reasons or individual circumstances.

Additionally, as management, we will consider how to handle and offer content of the talent within the game,
within feasible limits and taking into account the talent's own intentions and circumstances.
Please note, due to the nature of the content, it may be difficult to accommodate requests
due to multiple rights holders, contracts, or development constraints.

■Regarding talent graduation in the future
In the event of major changes such as a talent’s graduation in the future, we will consider how to respond on a case-by-case basis based on development progress and consultations with relevant parties, and will provide advance notice whenever possible.

Please note that, without prior agreement from the relevant parties,
without the consent of the talent themselves or the relevant parties.

As a basic principle, we will take care to minimize
any impact on players' game experience as much as possible.
・In principle, characters, items, and content you have already obtained will not be removed or suspended due to reasons such as graduation.
・Future additional implementations and the provision of new content may be discontinued depending on circumstances.

However, there may be cases where exceptions are necessary due to unavoidable circumstances (such as contractual reasons).
In such cases, we will notify you in advance before taking action.

■In cases of suspension or change in activity status
Because a talent's activities are diverse,
various changes may occur depending on the circumstances at the time.
We intend to operate the game while respecting talents' activities,
so certain in-game content
may be handled as described below.
・In cases where implementation of voice or performance is postponed due to temporary changes in activity status
・If songs, voice lines, etc. are to be implemented at a later date
・If the timing of delivery or the order of implementation is changed

These will be responses made taking into account the talents' activity status and circumstances in production and development.
If any response is required, we will inform you in advance as much as possible,
so we would appreciate your understanding.

it may be difficult to apply visual updates
to existing content.
We will consult with the relevant parties at the appropriate time and carry out the necessary measures;
please understand that development will require a certain amount of time.

■About the contact desk
For inquiries regarding this work and hololive Production,
please use the appropriate contacts below depending on the nature of your inquiry.
Please refrain from contacting the talent directly or reaching out to the talent’s streams or social media accounts.
Please understand and cooperate with us to protect the talents' activities and environment.

=============================================
○ Inquiries regarding game content, specifications, bugs, etc.
Please contact us via the [Contact Us] menu in game.

○ Inquiries about hololive Production and talents
Please contact the official hololive Production inquiry desk.
https://cover-corp.com/contact
=============================================

■To conclude
We want this work to be a game
that can be enjoyed for a long time while valuing both the talents’ activities
and the feelings of everyone who supports them.

As the management team, we will make appropriate decisions based on the circumstances
and continue the game so that everyone can play with peace of mind, while providing you with any necessary information.
Although there may be shortcomings or inconveniences at times,
we will continue to operate while addressing each issue one by one.

We appreciate your continued support for “hololive Dreams.”
